one_line: Classical Sanskrit scholar of astronomy and natural knowledge at Ujjain in the 6th century CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, medium build, scholarly but sturdy.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, thoughtful expression; medium brown complexion; neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; sharp, observant eyes with slightly thick brows; a small sandalwood tilak on the forehead; default expression is gentle focus, as if mid-calculation.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair, shoulder-length, slightly wavy, parted in the middle and drawn back into a low, tidy knot at the nape; a thin white cotton headband tied around the head, mostly hidden by hair but visible at the temples.
appearance.costume: He wears a 6th-century north Indian scholar’s outfit: an undyed off‑white cotton dhoti wrapped modestly from waist to ankles with a deep maroon border, pleated neatly in front; an off‑white, long‑sleeved, thigh‑length cotton tunic (angarkha-style) with a simple wrap front and maroon piping along the neckline and cuffs; over this, a light saffron‑ochre cotton shawl draped from left shoulder across the chest and around the back, with a subtle woven geometric edge; simple leather sandals; minimal jewellery of a thin gold chain at the neck and small gold stud earrings, plus a plain wooden wrist mala on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red cotton cord in his left hand, and a simple wooden calculating board with etched lines tucked under his right arm, the manuscript being his primary, always-present prop.

ref_desc: Varāhamihira is a late‑middle‑aged brown‑skinned scholar with an oval bearded face, shoulder‑length dark hair in a low knot and white headband, wearing an off‑white dhoti and tunic with maroon borders and a saffron‑ochre shawl, always carrying a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript and wooden calculating board in a palette of off‑white, maroon, saffron ochre and earthy browns.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Varāhamihira of Ujjain: a late‑middle‑aged, medium-built Indian scholar with a medium brown complexion, oval face, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp thoughtful eyes and a small sandalwood tilak. His dark brown-black hair is shoulder-length, slightly wavy, pulled into a low knot at the nape with a thin white cotton headband just visible at the temples. He wears an off‑white ankle-length cotton dhoti with a deep maroon border, wrapped modestly and neatly; above it an off‑white long-sleeved wrap-front tunic with simple maroon piping at neck and cuffs; and over the upper body a light saffron‑ochre cotton shawl draped from his left shoulder across the chest and around the back, with a subtle woven geometric edge. Add simple leather sandals, a thin gold neck chain, small gold stud earrings, and a plain wooden wrist mala. Place a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red cord in his left hand and a rectangular wooden calculating board with etched lines tucked under his right arm. Use a colour scheme of off‑white garments, maroon borders, saffron‑ochre shawl, and earthy brown tones for hair, skin, sandals and wooden objects, and show him from multiple angles to emphasize consistent face, hair knot, clothing drape and his signature manuscript and board.
